messages:
Eli (Design): dropping a rapid-proto for the Rollout List — compact rows, inline rollback, canary mini-bar, and keyboard-first interactions. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/proto/rollout-list-compact. want quick takes on copy + a11y + perf.
Marta (PM): looks good. product note: CTA must include the target version (so audit logs read cleanly). also show an undo TTL somewhere obvious (5m?).
Noah (Eng): inline confirm ok. impl idea: icon click reveals inline confirm (Confirm / Cancel) to prevent accidental rollbacks. we should virtualize lists > 100 rows. also avoid heavy DOM on expand — toggle visibility classes.
Sofia (A11y): a11y high level: percent & canary info must be in DOM (not hover-only). add aria-expanded on rows, aria-controls for the details panel, and aria-live="polite" on the rollout-status region so SRs get updates. ensure keyboard order: row -> timeline knob -> details -> rollback.
rollout-bot: automated scan: muted legend (#8B9398 on #FFFFFF) fails contrast (2.5:1). suggested palette token #3D4548.
Eli (Design): noted, will darken legend. copy options for CTA: 1) "Rollback to v{X}" 2) "Revert service to v{X}" 3) "Start rollback" — which do folks prefer? planning an A/B experiment for clarity.
Marta (PM): prefer 1 or 2. lean 1 because its concise and matches backend event wording. but test against 2 for clarity. include helper microcopy: "Undo available for 5 minutes."
Noah (Eng): +1 for 1. implementation note: include the version identifier in button text so analytics can attach without extra lookups. two-step inline confirm is cheap safety.
Sofia (A11y): prefer 1 too — explicit version helps SR announcements. for inline confirm make sure focus moves to the confirm button and Escape cancels back to the row toggler. add role="status" to progress containers and aria-atomic=true for tidy announcements.
Eli (Design): question on density: showing percent inline increases row height from 36px to 48px. options: a) always show small muted percent b) show percent only on focus/hover c) show as visually-subdued but in DOM and reveal full contrast on focus. preferences?
Marta (PM): avoid hover-only for key info. option c seems best — visible to keyboard users and low-noise for mouse.
Noah (Eng): option c is easy: keep node in DOM, CSS opacity low, on :focus-visible increase opacity. avoid visibility:hidden because SRs won't see it.
Sofia (A11y): agree with c. never use display:none/visibility:hidden for content SRs need. also add aria-roledescription="rollout-list" and ensure screen readers read: "Version v3.2, canary 5 percent" when focused.
rollout-bot: suggestion: add keyboard shortcuts doc (e.g., j/k to move rows, space to expand) and aria-describedby pointing to that help region.
Eli (Design): good idea. final UX decision needed: inline confirm vs tray/modal for rollback. product thinks inline for normal ops, modal for high-risk infra changes.
Marta (PM): agree. inline for service-level rollbacks; modal if migration flag or infra toggle present. add explicit audit message: "User X rolled back Service Y: v3.2 -> v3.1."
Noah (Eng): will implement feature-flagged modal path and websocket events for progress so UI shows realtime status. also will add virtualization spike.
Sofia (A11y): I'll re-run quick smoke after the figma update. checklist: keyboard order, aria-expanded, aria-live, legend contrast, focus-visible ring >= 2px.
Eli (Design): action items: 1) update figma with CTA "Rollback to v{X}" + helper "Undo available for 5 minutes", 2) darken legend to #3D4548, 3) annotate keyboard flow and aria attributes. will post updated frames by EOD. :sparkles:
